Buyei | Ethnic Group, Minority & Culture | Britannica
s: July 20, 1998 - A Chinese account of 1730 relates that the Buyei were a Chinese group banished to Guizhou in pre-Christian times. More likely they were a Tai group forced from more favoured agricultural lowlands into the poorer valley lands of the Guizhou plateau and hills. In the early 21st century they numbered nearly three million and still inhabited Guizhou, distributed mostly at the south of the province and in the valley of the Nanpan River.
